response.text:
I can do that, but this will change or remove your mail so I need a few clarifications before I proceed.

1) Action — do you want me to:
   - Archive the messages (remove from Inbox but keep them searchable in All Mail), or
   - Move them to Trash (they’ll be removed from Inbox and go to Trash; Gmail permanently deletes after ~30 days)?

2) Which messages exactly should I target? Common options:
   - All messages with senders whose address contains “uber” (e.g., from:@uber.com),
   - Any message that mentions the word “uber” (subject or body),
   - Only messages from specific Uber services (e.g., Uber Eats) — name them,
   - Limit to Inbox only, or apply to All Mail (including Sent)?

3) Preview first? I can first show a preview/count (e.g., “X messages matched; sample subjects/senders”) so you can confirm before any destructive action. I recommend this.

4) Confirm irreversibility: moving to Trash is reversible until permanently deleted; permanently deleting immediately is irreversible. Please confirm you understand.

Tell me your choices for 1–3 (or say “Do the safe option: preview first and then archive all from @uber.com in All Mail”), and I’ll proceed accordingly.
